thread:
Priya: Heads-up: YVR-edge provisioning started timing out around 01:42 PDT. netlink errors from vpc-leaf-3. Staging pool for H200 top-up is blocked and vendor handoff scheduled at 06:00 PDT.
Mark: How many GPUs impacted? single rack or multiple?
Priya: ~16 GPUs across yvr-rack-3 and -4. Total manifest is 36 H200s arriving. If we miss handoff we likely lose dock slot and vendor will rebook next available in +5 business days.
Luis: Can we N+1 to FRA or SEA pools? FRA latency penalty is large for latency-sensitive workloads. SEA would be cheaper but needs cross-AZ routing.
Priya: SEA detour is doable for non-latency-critical customers but will require brief DNS/route updates and a pool label to avoid double allocation.
Arjun (NexaSupply): We can hold shipment up to 4 hours on our side. AWB reference AWB-NX-774411. If you need an air-split (urgent 10 units) we can do it but there's a $2.1k expedite surcharge. Sea-only split adds ~48-72h customs delay.
SREBot: INCIDENT: netlink-flap detected in yvr-rack-3  01:45 PDT - ticket INC-2026-215 created.
Mark: Quick triage: Priya, can you reroute provisioning calls to local KV-cache fallback to reduce API roundtrips?
Priya: Yes, pushing a config to prefer local cache and lower batch window now. May recover ~60% of queued starts.
Luis: Ops cost check: 10-unit air expedite vs 4hr hold. If hold fails, then air surcharge $2.1k + repalletization risk. Ops emergency buffer covers $1k; need finance sign-off for rest.
Sam: @Priya looped in. If this is < $3k we can fast-track a charge approval, need cost brief.
Arjun (NexaSupply): If you confirm hold we will keep the pallet intact and waive repalletization if released within 4 hrs. If split executed we charge the expedite and handling.
Priya: Manifest we uploaded earlier:
```
manifest_id: MAN-2026-YVR-9102
carrier: NexaExpress
items: 36 x H200
scheduled_pickup: 2026-05-18T06:00:00-07:00
notes: hold-if-provisioning-fail
```
Luis: FYI we should tag the stuck units with `provision:stalled` and create a short-lived `sea-detour` mapping so scheduler won't allocate them twice. I'll prep the mapping.
Priya: Cache fallback pushed, monitoring now. 5m observation window.
Mark: If fallback drains >=10 nodes within 10m we hold and avoid split. If not, trigger AWB split at 06:05 PDT.
Arjun (NexaSupply): Holding until 06:05 PDT per request. Will confirm final AWB actions at 06:02.
Priya: Update after 6m: retries successful for 9 of 16, queue down to 7. Good sign.
Sam: Finance: prep the emergency approval doc in case we need >$1k.
Luis: I'll create the `sea-detour` pool and tag 7 remaining nodes. Also will coordinate DNS TTL drop.
Priya: If last_message_ts > 1775562100 we'll update, otherwise assume watch. Please react with :eyes: if monitoring.
Mark: Adding :thumbsup: to keep eyes on this thread.
Arjun (NexaSupply): Confirmed hold and will stand by for 06:02 finalize.
Priya: Thanks team.
